title: Field-aware invert of a prior insert-mode PasteClips command
aggregateCanonical: sha256 of sorted "digest  path\n" lines of sourceSha256
bounds: Field-aware invert of a prior non-tip insert-mode PasteClips of a copied left remnant at the 1s cut restores only that command's insert-paste write set when those fields still match the command's after-image. A later unrelated SetMarkers does not conflict: invert removes the pasted clip, restores the dest-shifted right remnant's start and the sequence duration, restores the followed stay cue, keeps the unmoved left remnant and its followed hello cue, and keeps the later markers. A later text edit of the followed stay cue, or of the unmoved hello cue, also does not conflict; invert keeps the new text. Insert paste still grows sequence duration by the package span and does not remove or vacate the source left remnant.

A later leave-gap MoveClip of the dest-shifted right remnant, or invert of the tip, is whole-group UNDO_CONFLICT and does not roll the database back. Official InversePatch kind stays restoreSnapshot. Linear undo/redo stay tip snapshot restores. Leaf-level rational n/d granularity is unchanged. This slice does not change production algebra, insertion order, or IMPLICIT_GAP, and does not officialize mid-clip insert paste invert, SetDissolve invert, or auto-close of a vacated source gap. Video and caption mute/solo stay refused at admission with FEATURE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED. Audio muted/solo stay SetAudioTrackState. syncLock is not toggled. Already-delivered edit semantics including overwrite-mode PasteClips stay unchanged. A diverging unlink invert remains LINK_OFFSET_MISMATCH. An overwrite that would uncover or crop a source cue remains ANCHOR_OUT_OF_RANGE. An overwrite that would overlap a followed cue and a dest remnant remains CAPTION_OVERLAP. The single-clip Move button stays MoveClip and is not used on this path. Captions still do not enter the internal clipboard; invert does not claim to clear that package.

A real UI path splits at 1s, adds hello and stay cues, copies the left remnant, sets collision mode to insert, pastes at 1s, adds a later marker, inverts the PasteClips command, then undoes, redoes, archives a fork, and exports a VTT sidecar. Preview and MP4 still refuse CAPTION_RENDER_POLICY_NOT_IMPLEMENTED. Extract is not required. Persist-path checks after archive/fork use caption text and anchors, the later marker label, remnant start times, the duration of the remnant that starts at 1s, and sequence duration 3, not pre-fork pasted ids.

Already-delivered ripple delete, ripple trim, leave-gap trim, leave-gap delete, move, lift/cut, split, extract, unlink/link, SetAudioTrackState, SetTrackState locked, caption-aware GroupClips/UngroupClips, invert of SetCaptions / SetMarkers / GroupClips / SetTrackState / SetAudioTrackState / UnlinkAudioVideo / ExtractAudioClip / SplitClip / leave-gap TrimClip / RippleTrimClip / rightmost RippleDeleteClips / leave-gap DeleteClip / leave-gap MoveClip / LiftClips / reject-mode MoveClips / overwrite-mode MoveClips / insert-mode MoveClips / includeLinks=false MoveClips / overwrite-mode PasteClips, insert-move leave-gap, overwrite, caption default/follow/interval/source-window, marker absolute default / clipLocal follow / ripple interval, 1000 seeded random undo, and the opened section-3 geometry matrix stay unchanged. Auto-close-on-move, new-track, cross-project bake, OS clipboard, source-interval crop, marker sidecar formats, a complete invert matrix, I-006, MP4 burn-in, and the table's 0.02s off-grid offset are not in this slice. Lifting a clipLocal-marker host remains REF_NOT_FOUND.
